notes.title: Update 1.0.14f3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello players!

We are thrilled to announce the arrival of version 1.0.14f3 of our game on the Epic Games and Steam platforms! This update brings a range of improvements and exciting features that will enhance your gaming experience. Here are the highlights:

[b]Epic Game Game Page[/b]
[url= https://store.epicgames.com/pt-BR/p/match-village-5f41dd] https://store.epicgames.com/pt-BR/p/match-village-5f41dd[/url]

[b]Steam[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2003370/Match_Village/

[b]New Languages[/b]
The game is now available in 10 additional languages, in addition to English and Brazilian Portuguese. The inclusion of these languages expands the accessibility of the game, allowing players from different parts of the world to enjoy the fun. The added languages are: 
[list]
[*] Italian
[*] Spanish
[*] Japanese
[*] Polish
[*] Russian
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Korean
[*] Arabic.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Our team has put in efforts to address minor performance and gameplay bugs reported by players. With these fixes, we aim to provide a smoother and issue-free gaming experience, ensuring that you can fully immerse yourself in our game.

We are committed to providing regular updates and continuous improvements to enhance your experience. To stay informed about all the latest news and future releases, make sure to follow us.

https://store.steampowered.com/developer/RisingMoonGames/

We appreciate your support and being part of our community. We hope you make the most of version 1.0.14f3 and have many hours of enjoyment with our game!

Best regards,
Alysson N. Moraes – Rising Moon Games.

notes.title: Update 1.0.12
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42596383/1816f35e2d10b63248680b36316a60823067c8be.png[/img]
Monoliths are much more important to the game's economy in version 1.0.12, now they will always ask you to place a building type next to it, this means that if you place the correct building around to monolith, you will get a building coin and village points of course. This was done to balance the game's economy, making gameplay fairer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42596383/2f964ea4f5365e00f4ed534c43004c8911a71ddc.png[/img]
Keep commenting on your experience with the game and leaving tips for improvements.

Thanks for the feedback!

Alysson N. Moraes,

Rising Moon Games.

notes.title: Update 1.0.11

notes.title: Match Village - Update 1.0.10
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
The first update of the Match Village game brings some performance improvements, correction of the scoring system and a small tutorial on the village button, more details below.

[h1]Performance Improvement[/h1]
The updated version of the game brings significant improvements in game performance, but remember that it is recommended to have at least 1gb of video memory to play Match Village.

[list]
[*] Optimization of the building rendering meshes.
[*] Added Object Culling system (disables objects outside the player's field of vision)
[/list]

For computers with video memory below 4GB or not supporting the MSAA (Multisample anti-aliasing) feature, it's recommended to turn off MSAA effects in the game's graphics settings. The game will remain beautiful and enjoyable, running at 60fps of course!

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42596383/3d5c33cbb3c64c68ce926acd4204f0680e7c352b.png[/img]

You can also disable the SSAO (Screen space ambient occlusion) effect in case of older computers or without a dedicated GPU.

[h1]Scoreboard[/h1]
Your score will be sent to the online leaderboard when starting a new island or when you lose the game, if your current score is higher than your online score, your high score will be updated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42596383/79cb4d7e6b49de08925fae005c60baecdf6512f4.png[/img]
 
[h1]village button[/h1]
The village button is filled according to the amount of points you get on each island, when the bar is first completed this little text warning is shown to the player, indicating that the button is interactive and clickable to explore a new island and earn new buildings to create even bigger villages!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42596383/c20b8d53b627bd5e84bd8fbb779c31d2dc0d9c3f.png[/img]

Whenever this button is available, a specific sound effect is played, indicating that you can click whenever you want. But I recommend that you complete all the missions of the buildings placed on the island before exploring the next one.

Achievement “Match 12”
For those who have questions about how the achievement is unlocked, just do what is shown in the video below.

[previewyoutube=o9CHryBSD84;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks everyone! keep commenting your experiences with the game, it will help to improve even more this and the next games that I will make.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2003370/Match_Village/

[i]Alysson N. Moraes,
Rising Moon Games.[/i]
